processes.orchestrator: bench/runtime/run.py; G1 client requests and G6 property cases
processes.shaper: bench/runtime/workers.py shaper: crosstalk.shaper.server.run() with ShaperSettings from CT_SHAPER_* env (uvloop), metrics exported to a file
processes.timer_server: bench/runtime/workers.py timer-server: TLS server measured for G2/G4
processes.clients: bench/runtime/workers.py *-clients: one process per measured phase; G3 direct and proxied streams come from the same client process

topology.notes: All processes share one host and its CPUs over TCP loopback.

soak.baseline_rule: gate baseline is the first sample at or after 60 s (warm-up); growth from the t=0 sample is reported alongside
